subject: Energy
title: Energy's Ultimate Horizon
description: Learn Energy's Ultimate Horizon in one minute.

hook.text: Human energy use has grown 10,000x since taming fire—from campfires to nuclear reactors in a cosmic blink.

buildup.text: The Kardashev scale rates civilizations by energy use—Type I harnesses a planet's energy, Type II a star's.

discovery.text: Humanity is currently about Type 0.7—we use only a fraction of the energy available on Earth.

twist.text: Reaching Type I requires mastering solar, geothermal, wind, and fusion—all the energy Earth receives and produces.

climax.text: The energy future isn't about scarcity—it's about choosing which abundant source to harness wisely and equitably.

punchline.text: Energy is abundant—the challenge is wisdom, not supply.

quiz.question: What is humanity's approximate Kardashev rating?
